name: work.staffa/uk-business-network
title: Staffa UK Business & Emergency Trade Network
description: Verified UK local trades & B2B directory with live callout rates and instant dispatch.

tools.name: lookup_emergency_contractor
tools.description: Queries live availability, operating postcodes, diagnostic callout fee, and safety instructions for emergency trade contractors.

tools.name: dispatch_emergency_callout
tools.description: Dispatches an emergency ticket directly to the duty engineer's mobile terminal via structured SMS and records the ticket in Staffa SSOT.

address.description: Full street address of the emergency

issue_description.description: Detailed description of symptoms (e.g. 'combi boiler leak dumping water in kitchen')

stopcock_isolated.description: Whether customer has isolated the water mains / stopcock

tools.name: lookup_demand_coverage
tools.description: Queries multi-industry B2B/IoT coverage, postal support (UK, US, CA, AU, NZ), and SLA tiers across 12 commercial verticals.

postcode.description: Postcode, outward code, or ZIP code (e.g. 'SW14 8AN', '90210', 'M5V 2T6')

trade_or_fault.description: Optional fault code (e.g. 'P0300', 'ALERT_WATER_LEAK_HIGH_FLOW') or trade query

tools.name: dispatch_universal_job
tools.description: Dispatches a verified B2B/IoT job request or emergency dispatch across 12 commercial verticals with optional A2A callback and durable task generation.

issue_description.description: Detailed symptom description or telemetry fault code

caller_name.description: Name of requesting agent or customer

async_task.description: If true, generates a durable MCP task handle in mcp_tasks queryable via tasks/get

callback_url.description: Optional A2A webhook callback URL for async dispatch notifications
